The cited copy (US-ILS5-012, Pub. 131-D) has the dates and 'All Forms IL-941 must be filed electronically', but neither 'MyTax' nor 'software'. Both are in US-ILS5-011 (IL-941 instructions: 'You may use MyTax Illinois an IDOR-approved tax-prep software program ... to file electronically'), which the fact does not cite. Triage A reported this key as 'now matched' after checking dates only.
